## 邮件1 → Prof. Yuriy Román-Leshkov (P0 最高优先级)

**Subject:** Collaboration Inquiry: AI-Driven Catalyst Design from Beihang University

Dear Prof. Román-Leshkov,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am Prof. Yuzhou Liu from the School of Chemistry at Beihang University (BUAA) in Beijing, and the founder of Heguang Zhicheng, an AI materials science company. I am writing to express my strong interest in exploring potential collaboration opportunities with your group.

I have been following your impactful work at the intersection of catalysis and AI-driven process optimization. In particular, I was impressed by your contribution to the DiffSyn framework published in *Nature Computational Science* (2026), which elegantly bridges generative AI with materials synthesis planning. Your expertise in catalytic reaction engineering combined with computational approaches aligns closely with our research vision.

At Beihang, our group has been developing AI-assisted catalyst design methodologies, with a focus on rational catalyst screening and reaction pathway optimization. We have established experimental capabilities in heterogeneous catalysis and are building computational pipelines that integrate machine learning with DFT calculations for catalyst discovery.

I would be delighted to explore potential synergies between our groups, such as:
- Joint development of AI models for catalyst screening and reaction optimization
- Exchange of computational methods and experimental validation protocols
- Potential co-supervision of graduate students interested in AI+catalysis

I would also like to warmly invite you to visit our campus at Beihang University when your schedule permits. We would be honored to host you for a seminar and lab tour.

Would you be available for a brief online discussion in the coming weeks? I am flexible with timing and happy to accommodate your schedule.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of working together.

Warm regards,

**Prof. Yuzhou Liu (刘宇宙)**
Professor, School of Chemistry
Beihang University (BUAA), Beijing, China
Founder, Heguang Zhicheng (和光智成)
